desc:
SPOOKY CEREAL: Enjoy crunchy monster nostalgia in every strawberry flavored bowl of Franken Berry cereal, featuring fun and tasty monster marshmallows

MERRY CREATURES: Celebrate the legacy of Jim Henson with a specially designed box featuring his furry, friendly monsters loved by kids and adults everywhere

MADE WITH WHOLE GRAIN: Provides 13g whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily)

PART OF BREAKFAST OR SNACKS: A spooktacularly tasty addition to breakfast or lunch box snacks, party snacks recipes, and Halloween bag stuffers

CONTAINS: One cardboard box of crunchy General Mills Franken Berry Cereal with Monster Marshmallows, 9.6 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
features:
Features

Strawberry-Flavored Frosted Corn Cereal

Delivers a fruity, sweet berry taste that kids and nostalgic adults enjoy.

Includes Monster-Themed Marshmallows

Marshmallows shaped like frightful friends enhance the fun and visual appeal.

Seasonal Limited-Edition

Specially released around Halloween, making it a collectible and festive treat.

Made with Whole Grain Corn

Contains a good source of whole grains per serving to support a balanced diet.

Fortified with Essential Vitamins & Minerals

Includes key nutrients like Vitamin D, calcium, and iron.

Colorful & Kid-Friendly Design

Eye-catching pink cereal with playful packaging that appeals to children and families.

Benefits

Fun, Themed Breakfast for Halloween

Adds excitement to breakfast time with a spooky seasonal twist.

Great for Themed Snacks & Parties

Can be used in Halloween snack mixes, party bags, or dessert bars.

Supports Nutritional Needs

Offers some daily nutrients through fortification while still being enjoyable.

Easy to Serve

No prep required—just pour into a bowl for a quick, tasty breakfast or snack.

Nostalgic Value

A classic monster cereal that brings back childhood memories for many.
ingredients: Whole Grain Corn, Corn Meal, Sugar, Corn Syrup, Dextrose, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Modified Corn Starch, Salt, Gelatin, Trisodium Phosphate, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Red 40, Blue 1 & 2, Malic Acid, Citric Acid, Rosemary Extract. Vitamins and Minerals: Tricalcium Phosphate, Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
